muyesser-irab:1-1.t:
﴿يا أيها النبي﴾: «يا» is a vocative particle; «أي» is the one addressed (munādā), a specific indefinite (nakira maqṣūda), indeclinable (mabnī) on ḍamma in the position of an accusative (manṣūb); «ها» is for drawing attention; and «النبي» is an adjective (ṣifa) of ﴿أي﴾.
﴿إذا﴾: «إذا» is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition.
﴿طلقتم النساء﴾: a past verb, its fāʿil (agent), and a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the clause ﴿طلقتم النساء﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the adverb's annexation to it.
﴿فطلقوهن﴾: the fāʾ links the apodosis (jawāb), and «طلقوهن» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi.
﴿لعدتهن﴾: the lām is a preposition, and «عدتهن» is a genitive noun; the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the object of «طلقوهن», on the assumption of an omitted muḍāf, i.e.: «لأول عدتهن» (at the beginning of their waiting period).
﴿وأحصوا العدة واتقوا الله ربكم﴾: «أحصوا» is an imperative verb conjoined to the imperative before it; «العدة» is a mafʿūl bihi; the clause «واتقوا» is conjoined to the clause «أحصوا»; and «ربكم» is a badal (substitute) from the Name of Majesty.
﴿لا تخرجوهن من بيوتهن ولا يخرجن إلا أن يأتين بفاحشة مبينة﴾: «لا» is prohibitive; «تخرجوهن» is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by «لا»; the wāw is the fāʿil, and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi; «من بيوتهن» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «تخرجوهن». «ولا يخرجن»: the wāw is a conjunction, and «لا» is likewise prohibitive. «يخرجن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn in the position of a jussive, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «أن» is maṣdar-forming (maṣdariyya); «يأتين» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn in the position of an accusative by «أن», and it, together with what falls within its scope, is in the position of an accusative as a ḥāl; «بفاحشة» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يأتين﴾; and «مبينة» is a naʿt (adjective) of ﴿فاحشة﴾.
﴿وتلك حدود الله ومن يتعد حدود الله فقد ظلم نفسه﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); «تلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «حدود الله» is the khabar (predicate); the clause is resumptive, a clause with no grammatical position. The wāw is a conjunction; «من» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; «يتعد» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the weak letter; «حدود الله» is a mafʿūl bihi; the fāʾ links the apodosis because it is joined with «قد»; «ظلم نفسه» is a verb, its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من».
﴿لا تدري لعل الله يحدث بعد ذلك أمرا﴾: a resumptive clause with no grammatical position. «لا» is negating; «تدري» is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and its fāʿil is «أنت» (you); «لعل» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh) conveying hope (tarajjī); the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause «يحدث» is its khabar; «بعد ذلك» is an adverb attached to «يحدث»; «أمرًا» is the object of «يحدث»; and the clause «لعل الله يحدث بعد ذلك أمرًا» stands in place of the two objects of «تدري», which is suspended (muʿallaq) from governing by the [particle of] hope.

muyesser-irab:2-2.t:
﴿فإذا بلغن أجلهن فأمسكوهن بمعروف أو فارقوهن بمعروف﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إذا» is an adverb of future time containing the meaning of condition; the clause «بلغن» is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by annexation; «أجلهن» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); the fāʾ is linking; «أمسكوهن» is an imperative verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi; «بمعروف» is a ḥāl (circumstantial); and «أو فارقوهن بمعروف» is conjoined to what precedes.
﴿وأشهدوا ذوي عدل منكم وأقيموا الشهادة لله﴾: «أشهدوا» is an imperative verb and its fāʿil; «ذوي» is a mafʿūl bihi, and it is the dual of «ذا» in the sense of «صاحب» (possessor of); «منكم» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «ذوي عدل»; «أقيموا» is conjoined to «أشهدوا»; «الشهادة» is a mafʿūl bihi; and «لله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أقيموا﴾, i.e. for His sake.
﴿ذلكم يوعظ به من كان يؤمن بالله واليوم الآخر﴾: «ذلكم» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and the clause «يوعظ» is the khabar (predicate); «به» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يوعظ﴾; «مَن» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent); the clause «كان» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. The noun of «كان» is latent (mustatir), its implied form being «هو» (he); the clause «يؤمن» is the khabar of «كان»; «بالله» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يؤمن﴾; and «اليوم الآخر» is conjoined to «بالله».
﴿ومن يتق الله يجعل له مخرجا﴾: the wāw is for resumption (istiʾnāf), and the clause is resumptive or parenthetical; on either view it has no grammatical position. «مَن» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; «يتق» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), made jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi; «يجعل» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «يجعل», or in the place of the second object; and «مخرجًا» is the object of «يجعل».

muyesser-irab:3-3.t:
﴿ويرزقه من حيث لا يحتسب﴾: «يرزقه» is conjoined to «يجعل»; «من حيث» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يرزقه﴾; and the clause ﴿لا يحتسب﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb, namely «حيث», to it.
﴿ومن يتوكل على الله فهو حسبه﴾: conjoined to what precedes. «من» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «يتوكل» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «على الله»: «على» is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يتوكل﴾; the fāʾ is linking; «هو» is a mubtadaʾ, «حسبه» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause is in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar of «من».
﴿إن الله بالغ أمره قد جعل الله لكل شيء قدرا﴾: the clause gives the reason (taʿlīl) for what precedes. «إن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun, «بالغ» is its khabar, and «أمره» is the muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct); «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «جعل الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «لكل شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «جعل» if it is in the sense of creating, or in the place of the fronted second object if it is in the sense of making-into (taṣyīr); and «قدرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object).

muyesser-irab:4-4.t:
﴿واللائي يئسن من المحيض من نسائكم﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya). «اللائي» is a relative noun in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ), a mubtadaʾ (subject). The clause ﴿يئسن﴾ is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «من المحيض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يئسن﴾. «من نسائكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿إن ارتبتم فعدتهن ثلاثة أشهر﴾: «إن» is conditional. «ارتبتم» is a past verb in the position of a jussive (majzūm) as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ). The fāʾ is linking; «عدتهن» is a mubtadaʾ, «ثلاثة» is its khabar (predicate), and «أشهر» is a muḍāf ilayhi (genitive construct). The clause ﴿فعدتهن...﴾ is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), and the condition with its apodosis is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ ﴿اللائي﴾. It has also been said: the clause ﴿فعدتهن...﴾ is the khabar of «اللائي», and the apodosis is omitted, its implied form being: ﴿فاعلموا أنها ثلاثة أشهر﴾ (then know that it is three months); the conditional clause with its apodosis is then parenthetical, with no grammatical position. The clause ﴿واللائي يئسن...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿واللائي لم يحضن وأولات الأحمال أجلهن أن يضعن حملهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «اللائي» is a mubtadaʾ whose khabar is omitted, its implied form being: «فكذلك» (then likewise), or «مثلهن» (like them), i.e.: their waiting period is three months. Had it been said that it is conjoined to «اللائي يئسن» as a conjunction of single words, with «عدتهن» serving as the predicate of them all, that would have been a good view. The clause ﴿لم يحضن﴾ is the ṣila of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «أولات الأحمال» is a mubtadaʾ, or else it is coordinated with what precedes; «أجلهن» is a mubtadaʾ; «أن» together with what falls within its scope is to be interpreted as a maṣdar (verbal noun) which is the khabar of «أجلهن»; «حملهن» is an object; and the clause is the khabar of «أولات».
﴿ومن يتق الله يجعل له من أمره يسرا﴾: the wāw is for resumption (istiʾnāf); «مَن» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; «يتق» is the protasis, made jussive by the dropping of the weak letter; the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «يجعل» is the apodosis; «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يجعل﴾; «من أمره» is a ḥāl; «يسرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿ومن يتق الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:5-5.t:
﴿ذلك أمر الله أنزله إليكم﴾: «ذلك» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), «أمر الله» is the khabar (predicate), and the clause «أنزله إليكم» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ومن يتق الله يكفر عنه سيئاته ويعظم له أجرا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); «مَن» is conditional, a mubtadaʾ; «يتق» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), made jussive (majzūm) by the dropping of the weak letter; the Name of Majesty is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «يكفر» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «عن سيئاته» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يكفر﴾ «[Translator's note: so in the source; the Quranic text reads «عنه سيئاته», and «سيئاته» is the object of «يكفر».]»; «يعظم له أجرًا» is conjoined to the apodosis; «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يعظم﴾; «أجرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿ومن يتق الله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.

muyesser-irab:6-6.t:
﴿أسكنوهن من حيث سكنتم من وجدكم﴾: «أسكنوهن» is an imperative verb, indeclinable (mabnī) on the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil (agent), and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi (direct object). «من حيث» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أسكنوهن﴾, so «من» is for the beginning of the extent (ibtidāʾ al-ghāya); it has also been said that it is partitive (tabʿīḍiyya), and it has also been said that it is redundant (ṣila), i.e.: «أسكنوهن حيث سكنتم» (lodge them where you dwell), the adverb being attached to ﴿أسكنوهن﴾. The clause ﴿سكنتم﴾ is in the position of a genitive (majrūr) by the annexation of the adverb to it. ﴿من وجدكم﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to an omitted badal (substitute) from the preposition and genitive noun before it, with the repetition of the preposition; it has also been said: an ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition). The clause ﴿أسكنوهن﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position.
﴿ولا تضاروهن لتضيقوا عليهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «لا» is prohibitive; «تضاروهن» is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by «لا», the sign of its being jussive being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil and the hāʾ is the mafʿūl bihi. The lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); «تضيقوا» is an imperfect verb made accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām of reason, the sign of its being accusative being the dropping of the nūn; the wāw is the fāʿil. The interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is made genitive by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿تضاروهن﴾. The object of «تضيقوا» is omitted, its implied form being «المساكن» (the dwellings) or «النفقة» (the maintenance); and ﴿عليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿تضيقوا﴾.
﴿وإن كن أولات حمل فأنفقوا عليهن حتى يضعن حملهن﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن» is conditional; «كن» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); the nūn is its noun, and «أولات حمل» is its khabar (predicate). The fāʾ links the apodosis; «أنفقوا» is an imperative verb, indeclinable on the dropping of the nūn, and the wāw is the fāʿil; ﴿عليهن﴾ is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنفقوا﴾; «حتى» is a particle of limit (ghāya) and of the genitive; «يضعن» is an imperfect verb, indeclinable on sukūn in the position of an accusative by «أن» necessarily implied after «حتى», and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; «حتى» together with what it puts in the genitive is attached to ﴿أنفقوا﴾.
﴿فإن أرضعن لكم فآتوهن أجورهن وأتمروا بينكم بمعروف﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «إن» is conditional; «أرضعن» is a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn in the position of a jussive as the protasis, and the nūn of the feminine plural is the fāʿil; «لكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أرضعن﴾; the object of «أرضعن» is omitted, its implied form being: «ولدًا منهن» (a child of theirs). The fāʾ links the apodosis; «آتوهن» is a past verb «[Translator's note: so in the source; «آتوهن» is an imperative verb.]», its fāʿil and its mafʿūl bihi, and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); «أجورهن» is a second mafʿūl bihi. «ائتمروا» is an imperative verb conjoined to «آتوهن», i.e. let some of you instruct others; «بينكم» is an adverb attached to ﴿ائتمروا﴾, and «بمعروف» is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿ائتمروا﴾.
﴿وإن تعاسرتم فسترضع له أخرى﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «إن» is conditional; «تعاسرتم» is a past verb, indeclinable on sukūn in the position of a jussive as the protasis; the fāʾ links the apodosis; the sīn is a particle of the future; «ترضع» is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ), and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis; «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to «سترضع»; «أخرى» is the fāʿil; and the pronoun in «له» refers back to the father.

muyesser-irab:7-7.t:
﴿لينفق ذو سعة من سعته ومن قدر عليه رزقه فلينفق مما آتاه الله﴾: the lām is the lām of command; «ينفق» is an imperfect verb made jussive (majzūm) by the lām; «ذو سعة» is the fāʿil (agent); «من سعته» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿ينفق﴾. The wāw is a conjunction; «من» is a conditional noun that makes [the verb] jussive, a mubtadaʾ (subject); «قدر», built for the one whose agent is not named (passive), is a past verb in the position of a jussive as the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), i.e. his provision is restricted for him; «عليه» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿قدر﴾; «رزقه» is the nāʾib fāʿil (deputy agent). The fāʾ links the apodosis; the lām is the lām of command; «ينفق» is an imperfect verb made jussive by the lām, and the clause is in the position of a jussive as the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ); the protasis and its apodosis are the khabar (predicate) of «من». «مما» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿ينفق﴾, and the clause «آتاه الله» is the ṣila (relative clause) of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿لا يكلف الله نفسا إلا ما آتاها﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «لا» is negating; «يكلف» is an imperfect verb in the nominative (marfūʿ); «الله» is the fāʿil; «نفسًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «إلا» is a particle of restriction (ḥaṣr); «ما» is a second mafʿūl bihi; and the clause ﴿آتاها﴾ is the ṣila of ﴿ما﴾, with no grammatical position.
﴿سيجعل الله بعد عسر يسرا﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. The sīn is a particle of the future; «يجعل» is an imperfect verb in the nominative; «الله» is the fāʿil; «بعد عسر» is an adverb attached to an omitted [word], which is the second object of «يجعل»; and «يسرًا» is the first object of «يجعل».

muyesser-irab:8-8.t:
﴿وكأين من قرية عتت عن أمر ربها ورسله﴾: a resumptive statement with no grammatical position. «كأين» is declarative (khabariyya), in the sense of «كم» (how many); «من قرية» is the tamyīz (specification) of «كأين», and it is in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject); the clause «عتت» is the khabar (predicate); «عن أمر ربها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿عتت﴾; and «رسله» is conjoined to «ربها».
﴿فحاسبناها حسابا شديدا وعذبناها عذابا نكرا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «حاسبناها» is a past verb, its fāʿil (agent) and its mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «حسابًا» is a mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), and «شديدًا» is a naʿt (adjective); «عذبناها» is conjoined to «حاسبناها»; «عذابًا» stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq, because it is a noun of the maṣdar (ism maṣdar); and «نكرًا» is a naʿt.

muyesser-irab:9-9.t: ﴿فذاقت وبال أمرها وكان عاقبة أمرها خسرا﴾: the fāʾ is a conjunction; «ذاقت» is a past verb, the tāʾ being the quiescent tāʾ of the feminine; the fāʿil (agent) is latent (mustatir), referring back to «قرية»; «وبال أمرها» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); «كان» is a defective (nāqiṣ) past verb, «عاقبة أمرها» is its noun, and «خسرًا» is its khabar (predicate).

muyesser-irab:10-10.t:
﴿أعد الله لهم عذابا شديدا﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position; or it is a badal (substitute) of inclusion (badal ishtimāl) from the clause ﴿وكان عاقبة أمرها خسرًا﴾, or a badal of part from whole. «أعد الله» is a past verb and its fāʿil (agent); «لهم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿أعد﴾; «عذابًا» is a mafʿūl bihi (direct object); and «شديدًا» is a naʿt (adjective).
﴿فاتقوا الله يا أولي الألباب﴾: the fāʾ is the fāʾ al-faṣīḥa (the fāʾ that discloses an implied condition), i.e. if you have come to know that, then fear Allah. «يا» is a vocative particle, and «أولي الألباب» is the one addressed (munādā), a muḍāf, made accusative (manṣūb) by the yāʾ, because it is attached (mulḥaq) to the sound masculine plural.
﴿الذين آمنوا قد أنزل الله إليكم ذكرا﴾: «الذين» is a naʿt of the one addressed, or a badal from it; the clause «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position; «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «أنزل الله» is a verb and its fāʿil; «إليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أنزل﴾; and «ذكرًا» is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:11-11.t:
﴿رسولا يتلو عليكم آيات الله مبينات﴾: «رسولًا» is made accusative (manṣūb) by the nunated maṣdar (verbal noun) before it, namely «ذكرًا»; or: it is a badal (substitute) from ﴿ذكرًا﴾, [the Messenger being made] the very remembrance by way of hyperbole; it has also been said: a badal from ﴿ذكرًا﴾ on the assumption of a muḍāf omitted from the first, its implied form being: «ذا ذكر رسولًا» (one possessing remembrance, a Messenger); it has also been said: the mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, i.e. «أرسل رسولًا» (He sent a Messenger); and it has also been said: the mafʿūl bihi of an omitted verb by way of incitement (ighrāʾ), i.e.: «اتبعوا» (follow). The clause «يتلوا عليكم» «[Translator's note: so spelled in the source, for «يتلو».]» is in the position of an accusative as an adjective (ṣifa); «عليكم» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) ﴿يتلو﴾; «آيات الله» is a mafʿūl bihi; and «مبينات» is a ḥāl (circumstantial).
﴿ليخرج الذين آمنوا وعملوا الصالحات من الظلمات إلى النور﴾: the lām is for giving the reason (taʿlīl); «يخرج» is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is made genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يتلو﴾. «الذين» is a mafʿūl bihi, and «آمنوا» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «من الظلمات» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿يخرج﴾, and «إلى النور» is a preposition and its genitive noun, also attached to ﴿يخرج﴾.
﴿ومن يؤمن بالله ويعمل صالحا يدخله جنات تجري من تحتها الأنهار خالدين فيها أبدا﴾: the wāw is resumptive (istiʾnāfiyya); «من» is a conditional noun that makes [the verb] jussive, in the position of a nominative (marfūʿ) as a mubtadaʾ (subject); «يؤمن» is the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ); «بالله»: the bāʾ is a preposition and the Name of Majesty is a genitive noun, and the preposition and its genitive noun are attached to ﴿يؤمن﴾; «يعمل» is conjoined to «يؤمن»; «صالحًا» is a mafʿūl bihi of ﴿يعمل﴾, or it stands in for the mafʿūl muṭlaq (absolute object), because it is an adjective of the maṣdar, i.e.: «عمل عملًا صالحًا» (does a righteous deed); «يدخله» is the apodosis (jawāb al-sharṭ), the hāʾ being the first mafʿūl bihi, and «جنات» is the second mafʿūl bihi by extension (ʿalā al-saʿa); the clause «تجري من تحتها الأنهار» is an adjective (ṣifa) of «جنات»; the clause ﴿ومن يؤمن بالله...﴾ is resumptive, with no grammatical position; «خالدين» is a ḥāl from the hāʾ, the meaning of ﴿من﴾ being taken into account after its wording had been taken into account; «فيها» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿خالدين﴾, and so is the adverb «أبدًا».
﴿قد أحسن الله له رزقا﴾: the clause is a second ḥāl, and here the wording of «من» has been taken into account. «قد» is a particle of verification (taḥqīq); «أحسن الله» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «له» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحسن﴾; and «رزقًا» is a mafʿūl bihi.

muyesser-irab:12-12.t:
﴿الله الذي خلق سبع سماوات ومن الأرض مثلهن﴾: «الله» is a mubtadaʾ (subject), and «الذي» is its khabar (predicate); the clause «خلق» is the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun, with no grammatical position. «سبع سماوات» is an object; «من الأرض» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to (mutaʿalliq) an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from «مثلهن»; and «مثلهن» is conjoined to «سبع سماوات», or it is made accusative (manṣūb) by an implied (muqaddar) verb after the wāw, i.e.: «وخلق مثلهن من الأرض» (and He created the like of them of the earth).
﴿يتنزل الأمر بينهن لتعلموا أن الله على كل شيء قدير﴾: the clause is resumptive, with no grammatical position. «يتنزل الأمر» is a verb and its fāʿil (agent); «بينهن» is a preposition and its genitive noun «[Translator's note: so in the source; «بين» is an adverb.]», attached to ﴿يتنزل﴾. The lām is the lām of reason (taʿlīl); «تعلموا» is an imperfect verb made accusative by an implied (muḍmara) «أن» after the lām, and the wāw is the fāʿil; the interpreted maṣdar formed from «أن» and the verb is made genitive (majrūr) by the lām, and the preposition and its genitive noun are also attached to ﴿يتنزل﴾. «إن» «[Translator's note: so in the source, for «أنّ».]» together with what falls within its scope stands in place of the two objects of ﴿تعلموا﴾.
﴿وأن الله قد أحاط بكل شيء علما﴾: the wāw is a conjunction; «أن» is an abrogating particle (ḥarf nāsikh); the Name of Majesty is its noun, and the clause «قد أحاط» is its khabar; «بكل شيء» is a preposition and its genitive noun, attached to ﴿أحاط﴾; and «علمًا» is a tamyīz (specification) transferred from the fāʿil.
